nodes.label: App Icon Brand Identity (Food Plate)
nodes.description: Primary app icon for kalori_takip (calorie tracker). Shows a stylized food plate on a circular light-blue (#E8F4FB) background with thick black outlines and a flat/cartoon illustration style. The plate contains: a grilled steak (brown #8B4513 with diagonal grill marks), green leafy garnish (dark green #2D6A4F), two red cherry tomatoes (#E63946), and yellow-orange side items (fries/bread, #F4A261). No text visible. Design language: bold outlines, vibrant flat colors, food-themed iconography consistent with a nutrition/calorie tracking app.
nodes.design_style: flat cartoon illustration, bold black outlines, circular composition

nodes.label: iOS Platform Icons
nodes.description: iOS app icons across all required sizes: 20x20@1x, 20x20@2x, 20x20@3x, 29x29@1x, up to 1024x1024@1x. All use the custom food-plate brand icon on a white/transparent square background (iOS applies rounded corners at OS level). The 1024px version is used for App Store submission.
